practiceReport.name: Christian Benford
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Every-down starter workload (86% snaps) — 82% active conversion baseline when logging Limited Friday reps.
factors: Did Not Participate (DNP) on Wednesday; remains sidelined from practice
Beat consensus: unlikely / not expected to suit up
practiceReport.beatComment: The cornerback sat out of Sunday's win over the Dolphins after exiting the previous week's victory over the Jets with the injury. Buffalo still has two more practices this week ahead of Thursday night's clash with Kansas City, but Benford is not on track to play at this point. If he can't go, Tre'Davious White, Jordan Hancock and Maxwell Hairston could be in line to see more snaps.

practiceReport.name: Dorian Williams
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Trench/box position (LB) — historically higher active rate through braced upper-body & ankle soreness (81% baseline).
factors: Missed prior game without practice participation — awaiting Wednesday report
practiceReport.beatComment: Williams did not play in Sunday's win over the Dolphins due to a calf injury that kept him out of all Week 11 prep. The inside linebacker's estimated presence Monday is promising, but he will likely need to suit up for on-field work Tuesday and Wednesday to get the green light ahead of Thursday night's Thanksgiving showdown with the Chiefs.

practiceReport.name: Dalton Kincaid
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Standard NFL positional availability baseline (78% Questionable conversion).
factors: Returned to Limited Participation (LP) on Wednesday following prior-game absence
practiceReport.beatComment: Kincaid didn't practice at all last week before being made inactive for Sunday's 26-9 win over the Dolphins. Though the Bills didn't actually practice Monday, Kincaid's 'limited' listing does represent an upgrade and suggests that the tight end has a chance to be available for Thursday night's game against the Chiefs. Further context regarding his Week 12 status is set to arrive via Tuesday's practice report, in any case.

factors: Questionable tag adjusted by player career prior (82%)
practiceReport.beatComment: Rousseau is coming off having recorded two more sacks against the Dolphins on Sunday. The linebacker now has four such games this season, and his 10.0 sacks in 10 games have already surpassed his previous single-season total of 8.0. The 26-year-old picked up a back injury in the win and will likely need to practice both Tuesday and Wednesday to avoid any injury designation ahead of Thursday's Thanksgiving showdown with the Chiefs.

practiceReport.beatComment: Hawes was in danger of missing this contest due to a shoulder issue, though he will avoid his first absence of the 2026 campaign Sunday versus Miami.
